newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CSN 1996 EPS raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CSN 1996 EPS raised.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it was maintaining its accumulate rating on Brazilian steel firm CSN.
-- It also said it upgraded its estimates for CSN's earnings per share to 3.02 reais from 2.39 reais for 1996.

-- Merrill Lynch said it raised forecasts "net of extraordinaries to incorporate the better-than-expected third quarter results and the recovery in domestic demand which we expect to prevail through the fourth quarter."

-- CSN reported a 79.7 million real net profit in the third quarter including an extraordinary gain of approximately 16 million reais, which if deducted, would bring the adjusted net income to 63.7 million reais, Merrill said. Even this figure, it added, exceeded the brokerage's forecast of 58.9 million reais in net income.
-- CSN common shares were trading at 27.50 reais, down 1.78 percent, at 1555 local time/1755 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
